protocol: NEW instrument (docs/15, D95): 50 resource claims sampled seed-17 from the 1,056-claim state, graded by the session model against each paper's own body_window (+abstract/title), BEFORE any precision number was reported. Labels frozen at write time. DEFECT if: (a) the source the extractor was given does not support the resource (background-knowledge fill-in); (b) the RELATION is wrong for the schema (a baseline or a judge recorded as P_BUILDS_ON); (c) the object is a generic term the prompt excludes (VAE, GANs, RAG-as-paradigm); (d) the subject is malformed (a title fragment or a stopword). NOT defects: short proper method names, mild relation stretches within a pid's stated scope (P_EVALUATES_ON covers 'trains on').
instrument_caveat: The grading file's '*** NOT FOUND IN WINDOW ***' flag searches only body_window, so a resource present in the abstract shows as not-found (items 11, 21 were graded PRECISE on the abstract). The flag is a prompt to check, not a verdict.
